strategy.overview: The numbered 1-5 drop bank prepares different awards. Targets 1+2 light the side captive-ball Extra Ball; 1+3 lights platform Extra Ball; 2+3 lights 500,000 there; 3+4 lights the lower-lane Extra Ball and a 100,000 side target; 3+5 lights platform Special. Completing all five lights alternating standup Specials and rear-bank Extra Ball. The Corner targets prepare the launcher, while each upper Extra Ball or Special lane needs one pass to prepare and a second to collect.
strategy.simpleOverview: Use the numbered 1-5 drop bank to prepare awards: 1+2 lights the side captive-ball Extra Ball, 1+3 lights the platform Extra Ball, and 3+5 lights platform Special. Completing all five lights the larger alternating-target and rear-bank awards. Each upper Extra Ball or Special lane takes one pass to prepare and a second pass to collect.
strategy.summary: Keep target 3 available because it completes four useful pairs. Choose the pair for the award you can reach, then collect that lit shot instead of clearing the rest of the bank without a plan.

quickInfo.name: Upper Lanes
quickInfo.summary: Pass once to prepare, again to collect.

steps.text: Knock down target 3, then choose 1 for platform Extra Ball, 4 for lower-lane Extra Ball and the side 100,000, or 5 for platform Special.
Shoot the corresponding lit platform, lane, captive-ball, or side target before pursuing a different pair.
When the bank is already advanced, finish all five targets to light the alternating standup Specials and rear-bank Extra Ball.
Use the upper Extra Ball and Special lanes as two-pass features: the first pass prepares the sequence and the second collects it.

alternatives.title: Launcher sequence
alternatives.when: Use this when both Corner targets are reachable and the numbered bank is in an awkward state.

steps.text: Hit both Corner targets to prepare the launcher sequence.
Return to the launcher while its sequence is available, then reassess the numbered bank after the feed.
Collect the alternating Specials at the standups or the Extra Ball at the rear-bank target while lit.

machineSetup: This guide is for the conventional Mundial 90 playfield, not the video-and-joystick Flip-VI variant grouped with it in the catalog.

Test the 1-5 drop bank, rotating platform, side captive-ball target, rear-bank target, both Corner targets, launcher, and the two upper two-pass lanes; confirm the installed Extra Ball and Special awards.

techniques.name: Drop Catch
techniques.instruction: Drop-catch a clean platform or lane return before choosing the next numbered drop instead of flipping at the bank on the bounce.

cautions.issue: Mundial 90 and Flip-VI share a catalog family but do not share the same cabinet or video features.
cautions.response: Use these routes only on the conventional Mundial 90 playfield, not the Flip-VI cabinet.
